date_notes: Folder name is the session date. The tsq start mark is UTC and lands a day later for evening sessions; nine blocks carry a stem-date typo. See docs/notes/tdt_corpus.md.

tdt_stores.note: Which store is which anatomy is a rig-wiring fact and is NOT recorded in the tank. Unconfirmed: do not resolve geometry by array number until an operator confirms.

variants.base: online sortcode in the tsq: 0 and 1 only, an accept flag rather than a unit id
variants.sort/<name>/: offline OpenSorter result, one .SortResult per store, codes 1-2 with 31 as the outlier bin
